reports.text: Reacting to the #BlueJays signing of Jazz Chisholm Jr., coming up live:
Jazz Chisholm and Jays are in agreement. Jays doing big things: 1 year plus a player option for a second year. Converts to club option if player declines. $6m signing bonus and guarantees $34.5M.

I understand the Jazz Chisholm Jr. signing will be divisive among some #BlueJays fans who watched him with the Yankees. This team grew stale by mid-2026, though. It needs some swagger. The 2015-16 Jays weren't all best friends. I think Jazz could be a fan favourite, and quickly.

Jazz Chisholm Jr. is in agreement with the #BlueJays The deal, per source, is 1-year, $18.5 mill. It comes with both a player and team opt for '28. Chisholm has a 16 million player option for 2028. The Jays could trigger a $40 million team option, if PO is declined. There is a $1.5 mill buyout Y2.

Paul Toboni keeps saying the Nationals can't assume their offense will continue to be great in '27, especially after the trades of Curtis Mead and Luis Garcia Jr. Reports by FanSided and @spencernusbaum.bsky.social of interest in Jazz Chisholm fit that theory. natsjournal.com/p/nats-still...

Latest notes with Will Sammon: -Red Sox acting way a big-market team with a good farm system should -Brewers mulling 1B options -Braves just getting started -Items on Jazz Chisholm Jr., Joe Espada, Kris Bubic and Zach Plesac -Ejections down with ABS www.nytimes.com/athletic/778...
What will surely be a fascinating Jazz Chisholm Jr. free agency has begun
